## Evidence index

Link input recordings, frames, reset/clock metadata, stage inputs/outputs,
specification provenance, requirements, frozen manifests, evaluator versions,
individual scores, failure logs, and cleanup evidence. Distinguish publicly
released artifacts from private evaluator records. State retention locations
without revealing credentials or unrelated host data.
